name: Gakken Holdings Co., Ltd.
summary: Gakken Holdings Co., Ltd. engages in educational, and healthcare and nursing business in Japan and internationally. The company operates classrooms for a range of children including preschoolers to junior high school students. It is also involved in publishing content business, such as issuing and selling publications through sales companies and bookstores; planning, production, purchasing, and sales of publications for kindergartens and nursery schools, childcare supplies, play equipment, apparel for teachers, etc.; and planning, development, and operation of nursing care service centers, mainly housing for the elderly with services.
